data.transcript: Can you summarize the details on page 1?

On page 1, it’s a short design note for a read-through cache in front of a metrics service. The authors describe the problem first: dashboards re-run the same expensive queries, which slows responses and loads the database. They propose a cache with a thirty second time to live and explicit invalidation when a new batch of data lands. They then compare two key schemes, one per query and one per time window, and explain why the per-window scheme gives a higher hit rate.
